Sygehus Lillebælt is a Danish hospital participating in the DANIBD registry, treating patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) through biologic medication therapy (BMSL). According to data from the period October 2023 to September 2024, the hospital treated 714 patients receiving BMSL treatment, with 399 patients (56%) diagnosed with Crohn's disease and 314 patients (44%) with ulcerative colitis [^src1].

The hospital's patient population reflects a near-even split between the two primary forms of inflammatory bowel disease. The data indicates structured documentation of patient demographics and treatment patterns within the DANIBD register, which tracks disease management practices across Danish hospitals and treatment centers for both pediatric and adult IBD patients, as well as documentation of primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) as a comorbid condition [^src1].
